run_optimizer_minimize: run an optimizer to minimize an objective function with a given budget and num workers
create_optimizer_ask_tell: create an optimizer and use ask and tell to iteratively evaluate candidates against a loss function
build_optimizer_recommendation: build an optimization loop that provides the best candidate recommendation after exhausting the evaluation budget
configure_ConfiguredOptimizer: configure a ConfiguredOptimizer with custom parameters and instantiate it with a parametrization and budget
load_optimizer_from_pickle: load a pickled optimizer from a file path and resume optimization from its saved state
